concepts.title: Vocabulary in Context (Shabdarth)
concepts.description: Understanding the meaning of difficult words found within prose texts and using synonyms or antonyms appropriate for the context.
key_ideas: Identifying difficult words in a passage

concepts.title: Sequencing Events (Ghatna Kram)
concepts.description: Arranging jumbled sentences or story events in the correct chronological order to reconstruct the narrative flow.
key_ideas: Identifying the beginning, middle, and end of a story
Connecting cause and effect in a narrative

concepts.title: Character Identification and Traits
concepts.description: Identifying specific characters based on their dialogue or actions and describing their basic personality traits.
key_ideas: Who said to whom (Kisne Kisse Kaha)
Describing character qualities (e.g., brave, greedy, kind)

concepts.title: Identifying Moral and Theme
concepts.description: Evaluating the story to determine the central message, moral lesson, or the most appropriate title.
key_ideas: Extracting the lesson (Seekh) from a story

concepts.title: Passage Completion (Cloze)
concepts.description: Filling in missing words in an incomplete prose passage to ensure the text makes grammatical and logical sense.
key_ideas: Using context clues to find missing words

concepts.title: Hindi Poems
concepts.description: Hindi Poems — part of the chapter on पद्य — Poetry.
key_ideas: Step-by-step problem solving for hindi poems

concepts.title: Meaning and Feelings in Poems
concepts.description: Meaning and Feelings in Poems — part of the chapter on पद्य — Poetry.
key_ideas: Core principles of meaning and feelings in poems
Step-by-step problem solving for meaning and feelings in poems
Real-world applications of meaning and feelings in poems

concepts.title: Recitation and Rhythm
concepts.description: Learning to recite poems with correct pronunciation, intonation, and musicality (Laya) to enhance oral expression.
key_ideas: Maintaining rhythm and flow while reading
Using voice modulation to express emotion

concepts.title: Rhyming Words (Tukbandi)
concepts.description: Identifying and grouping words that end with similar sounds, which give the poem its musical quality.
key_ideas: Understanding sound patterns at line endings
Differentiating between rhyming and non-rhyming words

concepts.title: Poetic Vocabulary
concepts.description: Understanding specific vocabulary and synonyms often found in poetry that differ from conversational Hindi.
key_ideas: Meaning of difficult words in context
Understanding word variations used for rhyme

concepts.title: Moral and Message
concepts.description: Extracting the central lesson, moral value, or social message conveyed by the poet through the verses.
key_ideas: Connecting the poem to real-life values
Summarizing what the poet wants to teach

concepts.title: Creative Expression
concepts.description: Encouraging students to complete incomplete verses or write simple couplets using rhyming words.

concepts.title: विशेषण — Adjectives

concepts.title: संज्ञा — Nouns
concepts.description: Introduction to nouns as naming words for people, places, animals, things, and feelings.
key_ideas: Identification of naming words in a sentence

concepts.title: सर्वनाम — Pronouns
concepts.description: Understanding words used in place of nouns to avoid repetition and improve sentence flow.
key_ideas: Replacing Nouns with Pronouns (e.g., Ram -> Vah)

concepts.title: लिंग और वचन — Gender and Number
concepts.description: Learning how nouns change forms based on gender (masculine/feminine) and quantity (singular/plural), and how this affects the verb.
key_ideas: Changing word endings (e.g., Ladka -> Ladki, Ladke)

concepts.title: शब्द भंडार — Vocabulary (Synonyms & Antonyms)
concepts.description: Expanding vocabulary by learning words with similar meanings and words with opposite meanings.
key_ideas: Choosing the right word for the context

concepts.title: मुहावरे — Idioms
concepts.description: Introduction to common idioms and phrases used to make language more expressive and interesting.
key_ideas: Common Class 4 idioms (e.g., 'Pet mein chuhe kudna')

concepts.title: अनुच्छेद लेखन — Paragraph Writing
concepts.description: अनुच्छेद लेखन — Paragraph Writing — part of the chapter on लेखन — Writing.

concepts.title: चित्रकथा — Picture Story
concepts.description: चित्रकथा — Picture Story — part of the chapter on लेखन — Writing.

concepts.title: अनौपचारिक पत्र — Informal Letter
concepts.description: Learning the format and style of writing letters to friends, relatives, and family members to share news or convey greetings.
key_ideas: Using appropriate greetings for elders and younger ones
Structuring the body of the letter informally

concepts.title: प्रार्थना पत्र — Application Writing
concepts.description: Writing formal applications to the school principal for sick leave, urgent work, or fee concessions.
key_ideas: Stating the reason for the request clearly

concepts.title: संवाद लेखन — Dialogue Writing
concepts.description: Creating a written conversation between two or more characters on a specific topic or situation.
key_ideas: Identifying the characters in the conversation
Using proper punctuation marks like colons and quotation marks
Maintaining the flow of the topic

concepts.title: कहानी लेखन — Story Writing
concepts.description: Constructing a complete story based on given hints, outlines, or a moral lesson.
key_ideas: Developing a plot from given hints
Creating a suitable title for the story
